{{Quote|The Hutts control everything on Sleheyron, and a slave is nothing to them.|[[Yuthura Ban]]|<ref name="KotOR" />}}
'''Sleheyron''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. Although it was based on [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Merchant/Legends|trade]], its powerful economy made Sleheyron one of the most important [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] worlds.

==Description==
{{Quote|I think they're trying to starve us into submission. Then they can make us slaves on the Hutt spice planets or disposable workers in the tibanna gas factories on Sleheyron.|[[Aaida]], about the [[Exchange]]|<ref name="TSL" />}}
Sleheyron was a [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] portion of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. The planet sat at the intersection of the [[Pabol Hutta/Legends|''Pabol Hutta'']] and [[Pabol Sleheyron/Legends|''Pabol Sleheyron'']] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]].<ref name="TEA" />

Sleheyron was a [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] world where the few remaining wilderness were uninhabitable, made of jagged spires of basalt slag. Most of the planet was covered of [[City/Legends|urban]] areas, including numerous industrial areas, [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] and refinery districts.<ref name="TB" /> Sleheyron economic muscle was second only to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], as was the level of intrigue that occurred there.<ref name="TEA" /> Most of this economy was based on [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] trade and on the refinement of [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna gas]] in [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]].<ref name="TSL" />

==History==
{{Quote|My memories tell me that, for a time, Bochaba was one of the most feared gangsters on Sleheyron.|[[HK-47]]|<ref name="KotOR" />}}
During the [[Pre-Republic era]], Sleheyron was originally a world of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Rakata Empire]]. The planet was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] and [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] between [[27,500 BBY|27,500]] and [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]], before the formation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Sleheyron joined the [[Hutt Empire]] and stayed in Hutt control for most of its history. However, Sleheyron was not explored by Republic explorers until the period between [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000]] and [[8000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

By [[25,100 BBY]], Sleheyron marked the boundaries of the Hutts' true dominion. [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]] tried to [[Battle of Sleheyron|take]] the planet in order to make it his ninth Throne. In the 25th [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of his rule, Xim launched a two-pronged strike at Sleheyron and [[Boonta/Legends|Ko Vari]] but he was successfully repelled by the Hutts. This defeat started the [[Xim Wars|conflict]] that finally lead to the fall of [[Xim's empire]]. By this time, Sleheyron was a treasure world into which only the most trusted slaves were allowed.<ref name="Xim Week" />

Several years before the [[Jedi Civil War]], [[Yuthura Ban]] was sold into slavery at a young age to [[Omeesh]] the Hutt, a Hutt [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] who [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] his slaves regularly. Yuthura Ban eventually entered her master's bedchamber and stabbed the sleeping Hutt to [[Death/Legends|death]] before leaving the planet and joining the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Following the [[Mandalorian Wars]], [[Bochaba]] the Hutt became a prominent presence on Sleheyron, thanks in no small part to the [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] protocols of [[HK-47]]. In fact, the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] slaughtered 322 of Bochaba's "[[Meatbag/Legends|meatbag]]" enemies in a single year for his master, including two Hutt households. Later, HK-47 would claim that some of his finest work was completed on this world. In the end, however, the Hutt was slaughtered in a particularly gruesome manner by the [[Exchange]].<ref name="KotOR" /> In the time following the Jedi Civil War, the planet's fuel reserves, one of the largest caches in the Outer Rim, were owned by [[Vogga]] the Hutt. After the destruction of the [[Peragus Mining Facility]] in [[3951 BBY]], Vogga was influenced by the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] regarding the [[Telosian Restoration Project|shipment]] of Sleheyron fuel to [[Citadel Station]], on [[Telos IV]].<ref name="TSL" />

[[File:Ziro-SWE.png|thumb|left|215px|Ziro the Hutt bore the golden tattoos of the wealthy Hutts of Sleheyron on his head, back, [[Limb/Legends|arms]] and tail]]
In his early [[Standard day/Legends|days]], [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro]] the Hutt worked as a [[loan shark]] on the planet before moving his operations to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Ziro had also gotten [[Color/Legends|golden]] [[Sleheyroni tattoo|tattoos]] from his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="TCW-TVG" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Thakba Besadii Diori]], a minor Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], operated from Sleheyron where he resided in a mansion in the company of his [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]] and a group of of [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] guards.<ref name="TB" />

Sleheyron was captured by the invader during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] but it was unknown what the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] did to the planet. The Hutts would not comment on its state, nor would they allow outsiders access to the planet. A [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] later, the world and the entire Hutt Space joined the [[Confederation]] against the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Sleheyron_KotOR.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A screenshot of the cut level from ''Knights of the Old Republic'']]
Sleheyron was originally planned to be included in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' as one of the planets where the player would discover ancient [[Star Map]]s, but was cut from the final release.<ref name="Armchair">{{WebCite|url=http://www.armchairempire.com/Interviews/knights-old-republic.htm|text=Knights of the Old Republic Q&A|date=2003-10-10|work=[https://www.armchairempire.com The Armchair Empire]|archivedate=20031016161302}}</ref><ref name="Fuel Quest">{{WebCite|url=http://www.lucasforums.com/showthread.php?t=146065|text=Fuel Quest Bug Help|work=LucasForums|archivedate=20090409024550}}</ref> Some screenshots were released by [[LucasArts]] before the completion of the game.<ref name="GameSpotGallery">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-knights-of-the-old-republic/images|text=Star Wars Knights of the Old Republic Images}} {{C|Specific screenshots: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210226093146/https://gamespot1.cbsistatic.com/uploads/original/mig/5/0/9/3/415093-knights_002.jpg], [https://web.archive.org/web/20210226094044/https://gamespot1.cbsistatic.com/uploads/original/mig/1/7/8/8/431788-knights_002.jpg], [https://web.archive.org/web/20210226094450/https://gamespot1.cbsistatic.com/uploads/original/mig/5/6/6/4/425664-knights_003.jpg], and [https://web.archive.org/web/20210226094654/https://gamespot1.cbsistatic.com/uploads/original/mig/1/7/9/0/431790-knights_004.jpg]}}</ref>

Among the music files of the game, however, there are two, titled "mus_area_slehey" and "mus_bat_slehey." The former served as the background music for the [[Mind prison|Rakatan mind trap]] sequence and the latter appeared during fights aboard the [[Star Forge]]. The name of both files suggests that they were originally intended to be the music for Sleheyron areas.

There was a modding team called Team Hutt that worked on a restoration of Sleheyron for ''Knights of the Old Republic.'' The project is seemingly canceled. The team had released some screenshots of the new module before going silent.<ref name="K1">{{WebCite|url=http://lucasforums.com/showthread.php?t=186244|text=Sleheyron Restoration|work=LucasForums|archivedate=20160326020338}}</ref><ref name="Team Hutt">{{WebCite|url=http://sleheyron.proboards49.com/index.cgi|text=Sleheyron Restoration|work=sleheyron.proboards49.com|archivedate=20081022104125}}</ref>
